info.title: Bluntly.ph API
info.description: Verified product & seller review platform. All error responses use the RFC 9457 problem+json schema. Identity is a FastAPI-issued JWT (ADR-010).

post.summary: Log in (OAuth2 password flow; username = email)

schema.title: Response List Products Api V1 Products Get

get.summary: Get a product (always retrievable; low_trust computed)

schema.title: Response List Reviews Api V1 Reviews Get

patch.summary: Edit a review (creates a new version)

schema.title: Response List Versions Api V1 Reviews  Review Id  Versions Get

post.summary: Cast or change a helpfulness vote on a published review

delete.summary: Remove your helpfulness vote from a review

post.summary: AI critique of a stored review (author or moderator)

delete.summary: Revoke the active referral link (stays published)

post.summary: Publish without a link (<=2* -> Honesty Fund, else approved)
Reject a queued review (stays hidden; author may resubmit)
Take a published review off the public site

get.summary: Referral link history for a review

schema.title: Response Link History Api V1 Admin Reviews  Review Id  Referral Links Get

post.summary: Import a monthly commission CSV (all-or-nothing, idempotent)
Run the Honesty Fund distribution for a cycle (idempotent)

schema.title: Response List Tiers Api V1 Membership Tiers Get

patch.summary: Assign a membership tier to a user (moderator)

post.summary: AI critique of arbitrary draft review text
Review a seller (one per reviewer; publishes immediately)

schema.title: Response List Seller Reviews Api V1 Sellers  Seller Id  Reviews Get

get.summary: Public seller profile with trust rating + dimension averages

schema.title: Response Get Transactions Api V1 Tokens Transactions Get

post.summary: Admin token grant/deduct (moderator; audited via ledger)

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Signed; positive grants, negative deducts. Non-zero.

CritiqueRequest.title: CritiqueRequest
CritiqueRequest.description: Ad-hoc critique of arbitrary draft text (also reused for stored reviews).

MembershipTier.title: MembershipTier
MembershipTier.description: Membership tiers (M1). Distinct from trust stages (reputation).

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem document — the single error schema for the API.

QueueSignals.title: QueueSignals
QueueSignals.description:
Advisory fraud signals (M2 slice 5) — moderator queue only, never public,
never auto-blocking.

referral_redirect_url.title: Referral Redirect Url
referral_redirect_url.description:
Public attribution link — exposed instead of the raw affiliate URL.
Only present once the review is published AND monetized.

ReviewUpdate.title: ReviewUpdate
ReviewUpdate.description: All fields optional; any change creates a new version.

RoleUpdate.title: RoleUpdate
RoleUpdate.description:
Moderator promote/demote between user and seller (M2 slice 4).

`moderator` is intentionally not grantable via the API.

SellerProfileOut.title: SellerProfileOut
SellerProfileOut.description: Public seller profile with live per-dimension aggregates (M2 slice 4).

TokenKind.title: TokenKind
TokenKind.description: Token ledger entry kinds (M2 slice 7). Spending rules are M3.

UserTrustOut.title: UserTrustOut
UserTrustOut.description: Public trust profile (M2 slice 3). Stages move only via recompute.
